# ExpansionPanel:event

<div class="api-badges"><span class="api-badge api-badge--since">since 1.5.10</span></div>

Set a handler called when an event (EVT_CLOSE / EVT_OPEN) is received.

```lua
panel:event(handler)
```

## Parameters

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `handler` | function | yes |  |

## Returns

Nothing.
